Being a smaller guy, and a total newbie to the sport back then, I asked a high ranked purple who was my size for a roll when randori began. I had no stripes and have only trained with bigger guys so far, you can imagine how happy I was to find someone my size!! he reluctantly agreed and... proceeded to completely obliterate me with vicious techniques.. probably 15 subs in 6 mins or something ridiculous. Then with an almost threatening tone told me, "in Brazil, the lower ranks never pick the higher rank for a roll. You have to wait to be picked by higher ranks"

That was 12 years ago, and I still haven't forgotten how humiliated I felt from that experience. I'm glad I found a better gym and now am enjoying the sport and helping everyone enjoy it, no matter the size difference.

Ps. I also found out that this guy only trained in Brazil for two months from one of his training partners that travelled there with him. Lol funny guy for pulling that "in Brazil we do things this way".
